@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: This news reporter u______red the ugly truth about child labor in the country.
= uncovered
~詞義 uncover（v.）揭露
~原文 This news reporter uncovered the ugly truth about child labor in the country.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jenny wasn't e______e for the internship because she was too young to apply for it.
= eligible
~詞義 eligible（adj.）有資格的
~原文 Jenny wasn't eligible for the internship because she was too young to apply for it.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It is my dream to be a p______y chef; I love making and eating desserts.
= pastry
~詞義 pastry（n.）糕點
~原文 It is my dream to be a pastry chef; I love making and eating desserts.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Mandy has naturally curly hair, and if she doesn't use conditioner, her hair gets t______ed.
= tangled
~詞義 tangle（v.）使糾結
~原文 Mandy has naturally curly hair, and if she doesn't use conditioner, her hair gets tangled.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: That is a f______s dress, and Lisa looks great in it.
= fabulous
~詞義 fabulous（adj.）絕佳的
~原文 That is a fabulous dress, and Lisa looks great in it.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: We got a new electric wheelchair for our grandfather, and it is much easier for him to ______ than his previous manual one.
A: acquaint
B: facilitate
C: manipulate
D: patch
= C
~詞義 manipulate（v.）操控
~原文 We got a new electric wheelchair for our grandfather, and it is much easier for him to manipulate than his previous manual one.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Kevin won several speech competitions when he was growing up, and he keeps all the ______ on his bookshelf.
A: batches
B: chapels
C: saddles
D: trophies
= D
~詞義 trophy（n.）獎杯
~原文 Kevin won several speech competitions when he was growing up, and he keeps all the trophies on his bookshelf.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Burning plastics releases ______ smoke that threatens both human health and the environment.
A: tactical
B: hazardous
C: striking
D: legislative
= B
~詞義 hazardous（adj.）危險的
~原文 Burning plastics releases hazardous smoke that threatens both human health and the environment.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There has been a(n) ______ in the company's sales, so it may achieve its yearly sales target faster than expected.
A: acceleration
B: decline
C: mandate
D: manipulation
= A
~詞義 acceleration（n.）加速
~原文 There has been a(n) acceleration in the company's sales, so it may achieve its yearly sales target faster than expected.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Nina has made some investments because she is worried that her ______ will not be enough to support her after retirement.
A: certainty
B: salmon
C: pension
D: tuition
= C
~詞義 pension（n.）退休金
~原文 Nina has made some investments because she is worried that her pension will not be enough to support her after retirement.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: accounting
B: exiled
C: chaos
D: deceived
E: pathetic
F: masculine

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The man lives a(n) ______ life because he has only money and no true friends.
= E
~詞義 pathetic（adj.）可憐的
~原文 The man lives a(n) pathetic life because he has only money and no true friends.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The general was ______ from his homeland to a distant island after refusing to support the new government.
= B
~詞義 exile（v.）放逐
~原文 The general was exiled from his homeland to a distant island after refusing to support the new government.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Not every man has to show ______ qualities; a man can have feminine traits, too.
= F
~詞義 masculine（adj.）男子氣概的
~原文 Not every man has to show masculine qualities; a man can have feminine traits, too.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The teacher left the classroom for just a few moments, and now the classroom is in total ______.
= C
~詞義 chaos（n.）混亂
~原文 The teacher left the classroom for just a few moments, and now the classroom is in total chaos.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The scammer ______ numerous victims into giving him their money by telling them he could help them earn a fortune.
= D
~詞義 deceive（v.）欺騙
~原文 The scammer deceived numerous victims into giving him their money by telling them he could help them earn a fortune.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: tactics
B: scarred
C: customs
D: hauled
E: heir
F: scenario

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: When passing through ______, you may be asked a few questions, such as the reason for your visit.
= C
~詞義 customs（n.）海關
~原文 When passing through customs, you may be asked a few questions, such as the reason for your visit.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The young prince is the ______ to the crown. That is, he will become king once his father passes away.
= E
~詞義 heir（n.）繼承者
~原文 The young prince is the heir to the crown. That is, he will become king once his father passes away.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The doctor explained that, in the best-case ______, the patient could recover fully within two months.
= F
~詞義 scenario（n.）局面
~原文 The doctor explained that, in the best-case scenario, the patient could recover fully within two months.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The fisherman ______ his boat out of the water and tied it to a post.
= D
~詞義 haul（v.）用力拖
~原文 The fisherman hauled his boat out of the water and tied it to a post.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The tragic incident left the man ______ for life. He could never forget that terrible event.
= B
~詞義 scar（v.）留下傷疤
~原文 The tragic incident left the man scarred for life. He could never forget that terrible event.
